target: Kernel-formalize, on actual full symmetric column-sum words (DecimalDigits/FoldedDecimal semantics of LychrelDigitSums.lean, q symmetric of width L, entries <= 18, nextColumns), the maximal 0/18-run ancestry law of ABSORBING_CORE.md sec. 2: for c in {0,18}, h=[c=18], a maximal run [a,b) of c (b<=L): (i) no overflow, b-a>=2: for i in [a,b), nextColumns q L i = c iff (i=a -> carry q a = h) and (i=b-1 -> carry q (L-b) = h); (ii) no overflow, singleton: survives iff both carries = h; (iii) overflow: nextColumns = c exactly on [a+1,b) within [a,b]; (iv) no-merging: the output neighbours of the surviving descendant are not c; hence descendant length <= ell - overflowBit. Then the actual-orbit corollary of 2026-10-15-ancestry-potential-bound: if the tracked descendant of a maximal run of initial length ell>0 survives to time t, then t + lowerPotential(p_t) <= 4(ell-1) + lowerPotential(p_0), so extinction by 4 ell - 3 + psi(p_0) <= 4 ell + 1.
